A transparent follow-up review should verify expected visibility and equipment needs.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Favors using the full budget for an inter-city tournament with catering and prizes to increase club visibility and recruitment.","influence":0.32},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Favors investing the full budget in new educational equipment because existing boards, clocks, and teaching materials are worn.","influence":0.40},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Favors an even split between a smaller tournament and educational equipment to balance outreach and internal educational quality.","influence":0.28}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The options represent legitimate but competing objectives, and no argument decisively establishes that one full-budget allocation will achieve its intended results. Use a ranked or scored social-choice vote, preferably after presenting costed variants, then adopt a monitored hybrid allocation with measurable targets and a later review. This preserves fairness while addressing the strongest practical concerns identified by agent_2."}
